patch_description: This implementation replaces stochastic single-point annealing with deterministic alternating linear programming. With all x-coordinates fixed, every signed triangle determinant is linear in the y-coordinates; conversely, with y fixed it is linear in x. The algorithm preserves the oriented-matroid sign pattern of each seeded arrangement and alternately solves exact max-min linear programs for x and y, monotonically improving the bottleneck triangle area. Multiple deterministic low-discrepancy and jittered lattice seeds explore distinct sign patterns efficiently, while every point remains inside the fixed unit-area reference triangle.
